decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical DOS error and INT 24 definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
dossym.inc includes error.inc; BIOS MSCHAR and COMMAND TDATA also include it directly.
DOS DIRCALL uses error_access_denied and error_path_not_found constants; its previously compared 521-byte contribution matches target MSDOS.SYS (review 055).
Previously compared BIOS MSDISK and DOS FAT contributions match their 1945 and 984 target bytes respectively (reviews 012 and 065).
limitations: These comparisons support only constants exercised by selected modules; they do not individually prove every error code or complete binary identity. Final links remain pending.
